words.meaning: The pleasant, earthy scent that frequently accompanies the first rain after a long period of warm, dry weather.
words.sentence1: As the summer drought broke, a rich petrichor rose from the thirsty earth. (As the summer drought broke, a rich petrichor rose from the thirsty earth.)
words.sentence2: She closed her eyes to deeply inhale the soothing petrichor outside her window. (She closed her eyes to deeply inhale the soothing petrichor outside her window.)

words.meaning: Relating to the crisp, luminous freshness of early morning nature.
words.sentence1: El viento matutino acaricio las hojas cubiertas de rocio en el jardin. (The morning wind caressed the dew-covered leaves in the garden.)
words.sentence2: Disfrutamos de un paseo matutino bajo los arboles dorados del bosque. (We enjoyed a morning walk beneath the golden trees of the forest.)

words.meaning: A soft, delicate mist wrapping the autumn landscape at dawn.
words.sentence1: Une douce brume enveloppait la vallee endormie au lever du jour. (A soft mist enveloped the sleeping valley at daybreak.)
words.sentence2: A travers la brume, les premiers rayons du soleil dore percetaien. (Through the mist, the first rays of golden sun were piercing.)

words.meaning: The mesmerizing interplay and shifting patterns of clouds across the seasonal sky.
words.sentence1: Das Wolkenspiel am herbstlichen Himmel faszinierte alle Wanderer. (The play of clouds in the autumn sky fascinated all the hikers.)
words.sentence2: Wir beobachteten das stetige Wolkenspiel ueber den Berggipfeln. (We watched the continuous play of clouds over the mountain peaks.)

words.meaning: The chilling wind that heralds the arrival of late autumn and early winter.
words.sentence1: Kogarashi ga fukinuke, kyonen no ha ga odoru yoni maiagatta. (The cold seasonal wind blew through, and last year's leaves swirled up as if dancing.)
words.sentence2: Kogarashi o kanji nagara, kanojo wa fuyu no kooto o gyutto shibotta. (Feeling the chill of the early winter wind, she tightened her winter coat.)

words.meaning: Glistening morning dew resting gently on vernal blossoms.
words.sentence1: La rugiada mattutina faceva brillare i petali dei fiori primaverili. (The morning dew made the petals of the spring flowers shine.)
words.sentence2: I fili d'erba erano coperti da una fresca rugiada argentea. (The blades of grass were covered with fresh silvery dew.)

words.meaning: The vibrant, picturesque natural scenery that changes magnificently across the four seasons.
words.sentence1: Chuntian de fengguang shifen miren, zhen shi taodi de hao shijie. (The spring scenery is extremely enchanting, truly a great time for an outing.)
words.sentence2: Qiu gaishuang de fengguang rang ren liuliu wangfan, bu shi zai jian. (The crisp autumn scenery makes people forget to return, wishing to stay forever.)

words.meaning: The radiant, amber glow of sunset reflecting across autumn fields.
words.sentence1: Eunbit deulpan wie bukeureoun noreul bitkkari muldeureotda. (A shy sunset glow dyed across the silvery fields.)
words.sentence2: Gayeo-un noreul kkeuteuro saramdureun jibeuro balgeoreumeul omgyeotda. (With the fading autumn sunset glow at the end, people moved their steps toward home.)

words.meaning: The sweet, ephemeral dew drops gathered inside freshly bloomed seasonal flowers.
words.sentence1: Plear phka pich ban janh-jany phka srey knong pich preuksa. (The flower dew glittered brightly on the blossom petals in the morning forest.)
words.sentence2: Knea ban luy chenh Plear phka dermbi thver osul thmey. (They collected flower dew to make a new natural fragrance.)

words.meaning: A golden-hued leaf gently descending during the crisp transition of autumn.
words.sentence1: Enkele gouden herfsblaar het saggies op die nat grond neergedwarrel. (A single golden autumn leaf drifted softly down onto the wet ground.)
words.sentence2: Sy het 'n mooi herfsblaar opgetel en dit in haar dagboek gedruk. (She picked up a beautiful autumn leaf and pressed it in her diary.)
